facts.text: The Kansas Commitment guarantees grants and scholarships to pay base tuition and mandatory fees for Kansans with a family income of $75,000 or less.

sources.title: Kansas Commitment | Financial Aid & Scholarships
sources.quote: The commitment guarantees enough scholarships and grants to pay for undergraduate base tuition and required student/wellness fees for Kansans who meet academic qualifications and have a family income of $75,000 or less (AGI/Adjusted Gross Income).
